elements.select: Choose with `Picker` (a `Listbox` with its trigger attached), `Listbox`, or `Combobox` from `@charcuterie/ui` — not a raw `<select>`, which paints as the OS widget and cannot be restyled.
elements.Select: `Select` is deprecated and is removed in the next `@charcuterie/ui` major. `Picker` is the drop-in: same `label`, `options`, `value`, `onChange`.
